title: draft-ietf-httpapi-idempotency-key-header-07
snippet: The HTTP Idempotency-Key request header field can be used to make non-idempotent HTTP methods such as POST or PATCH fault-tolerant. An idempotency key is a unique value generated by the client which the resource uses to recognize subsequent retries of the same request. It is RECOMMENDED that a UUID or a similar random identifier be used as an idempotency key.
claim: Idempotency-Key HTTP header draft-07 (expires April 2026) uses UUID for client-side request deduplication.

title: Idempotency Is Easy Until the Second Request Is Different
snippet: Content hashing detects duplicates; an idempotency key identifies one intended operation. Race conditions can occur when the timing and lack of atomic commitment of the entire operation (lock acquisition, database write, deduplication record write) leads to duplicate actions.
claim: Idempotency key identifies operation intent; race conditions require atomic commitment of full operation.
